تسجيل الدخول لإدارة المحتوى

عدّل القصص وروابط PDF والألعاب المصغرة مباشرة بدون إعادة بناء التطبيق.

إرشادات رمز الوصول (Token): أنشئ رمز وصول دقيق (Fine-grained personal access token) من حسابك في GitHub، واجعله مقتصراً على هذا المستودع فقط مع منحه صلاحية القراءة والكتابة للمحتوى (Contents: Read and write). يُحفظ الرمز محلياً على هذا الجهاز فقط ولا يُعرض أو يُسجّل.

``` Wait—let me check! I must NOT output `` after ``! Let me make sure I output cleanly without any trailing tags or backticks. Let me carefully verify everything before outputting. Wait: in the thought process I just noticed I accidentally drafted a stray line at the end of my thought—obviously I will output ONLY the clean HTML document from `` to `` with nothing outside! Let's do a quick final checklist of the code we are about to output: 1. `` is the very first script in the document. 2. Uses only `window.RTAdmin`: - `RTAdmin.isLoggedIn()` - `RTAdmin.login(user, repo, token)` - `RTAdmin.logout()` - `RTAdmin.readJson(file)` - `RTAdmin.writeJson(file, data, sha)` - `RTAdmin.imageToDataUrl(file, 480, 0.7)` 3. Never logs or displays the token (`type="password"`, cleared immediately after `login()` resolves/rejects). 4. Manages `comics.json`, `games.json`, `pdf_links.json`. 5. Reads each file first, preserves exact item shape (`cover` for `comics.json` & `games.json`, `image` for `pdf_links.json`) and preserves all unknown fields via `cloneItem(fs.items[state.editingIndex])`. 6. Supports list, add, edit, delete, reorder (move up / move down), pick pictures from gallery (using `imageToDataUrl(..., 480, 0.7)`), Save button calling `writeJson` with success/error messages, and Logout button. 7. Links to `home.html` cleanly in the app bar. 8. Chromium 78 compatible: - No `?.`, no `??`, no CSS `gap`, no `clamp()`/`min()`/`max()`, no `inset: 0`, no `aspect-ratio`, no `replaceAll`. - Note: `target.closest` IS supported in Chromium 41+, and `Object.assign` in Chromium 45+, `Array.isArray` in Chromium 5+. 9. Offline ready: inline CSS/JS, inline SVG icons, zero emoji, zero audio tags. 10. `dir="rtl"` and `lang="ar"`, viewport meta tag, touch targets >= 44px, `localStorage` wrapped in `try/catch`, `env(safe-area-inset-top)` / `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`. Everything is verified. Outputting the single HTML document now. لوحة تحكم المالك - كوميكس أوفرلاي
